name: Robosynthesis
description:
About This Game

Robosynthesis is a 3D Action / Puzzle Platformer, where you control SUNNI – the robot who’s just been re-activated after a new ray of sun cracked through their underground facility.

The twist? Your movement, health, and ammo all use precious solar energy. Plan your actions carefully to seek freedom, as every step may be your last.

A new discovery lurks behind every corner. Will SUNNI escape the facility... and uncover what happened long ago?

FEATURES

  • Roughly 20 to 40 minutes of playtime for a first playthrough.

  • 3 large main levels.

  • 10 secret data logs to collect.

  • Museum with 40+ pieces of concept art, design sketches, and early game screenshots.

  • 2 bonus levels referencing other Cocoteam games..?!

  • An optional retro pixelation filter.

OUR STORY

Robosynthesis was developed with a core team of five students for Senior Project @ Eastern Michigan University. The game was created from scratch within one semester.
